name: Mongolian People's Republic (1924–1940)
description: A red field with a double swallow-tailed fly, bearing a yellow soyombo emblem rising from a green lotus in the centre flanked by two columns of yellow Mongolian script; the fly is divided by two white horizontal panels.
history: Flag described in the first constitution of the Mongolian People's Republic, adopted on 26 November 1924 after the death of the Bogd Khan: a red banner with the soyombo, the national symbol, on a lotus. It was replaced by the second constitution of 30 July 1940 with a red flag bearing the state emblem.

features.role: two white panels in the swallow-tailed fly
